preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string must be lowercase and contain no spaces.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == 2 and all(isinstance(item, str) for item in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must be a list containing exactly two strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout[0] == ''.join(s[i].upper() if i % 2 == 0 else s[i] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: The first string in the output must have letters at even indexes capitalized.

postconditions.expression: stdout[1] == ''.join(s[i].upper() if i % 2 != 0 else s[i] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: The second string in the output must have letters at odd indexes capitalized.
